method: Player deaths rest on the death probe 1361 (Dunwall tower, product controller, both source roles): the source attacks tutorial guard 2 once, then stands still with health not held until native GameOver, while the observer camera is re-aimed at the source after every health drop (1361f on). A player's death is either the native Dead state (player state 15, arkPlayerStateDead, vtable RVA 0x1c82478 from its RTTI) with no scene, or the guard's finisher (state 38, arkPlayerStateNpcFatality, vtable RVA 0x1c3d878) playing npc_fatality_guards (subscene npc, 4000 ms) (confirmed static and runtime). Since 1214cv the source sends either as action 25 with one directional collapse (combat variants 24-27: front, back, left, right, from the nearest living NPC relative to the facing), which the partner plays from bank 72 (the native generic_sleepdart falls, sampled offline and retargeted per role from the role's own skeleton, cut to the 1.8-2.2 s collapse) and holds at the end pose; 1214cw/cx time a finisher's collapse on the native fatality scene clock to the native player body's fall (npc-fatality-timing-v1362.json), so the partner is down before GameOver. Each probe case passes when, from the first dead or finisher sample to GameOver, the partner presents a death collapse at full presentation and combat weight in 80% of the samples. Native GameOver then retires the dead source's stream and the partner leaves the world until the shared checkpoint reload (shared death and checkpoint recovery are the requested policy). NPC deaths caused by each source role are presented and shared through the native takedown scenes and corpse authority (takedown-variants-v1254k, audits 1257 and 1353).

items.scope: Player-character death in both roles, both native kinds (plain death and the guards' finisher), presented as a full-body directional collapse held to GameOver; NPC deaths caused by either source role presented and shared with their corpses.

visual.verdict: Corvo reels back from the guard's blow against the bookshelf and drops onto his back across the book stacks, staying down.
Emily is struck, staggers back and folds to the floor beside the book stacks while the guard stands over her.
The guard seizes Corvo and stabs him while he stands held; Corvo sinks to his knees, falls forward and lies face down before GameOver.

The guard grabs Emily, who stands held while he strikes, then staggers and sinks to her knees; on 1214cw GameOver removed her before she lay down. 1214cx starts the finisher collapse 0.4 s earlier, which 1361q and 1361s verify on Corvo (down before GameOver); the timing path is the same for both roles. On 1214cy the guard in the joiner world is a host-driven replica, so her deaths arrive as relayed hits (plain death, 1361t-v).
Corvo falls from above onto the guard, drives him down and rises with the sword raised over the body.
Emily lands behind the guard from above and he crumples forward onto the floor; she straightens over the body.
